context: Tests Step 6 (build collections from the now-searchable assets). The agent must drive scripts/agent/create-collections.js (dry-run then live) rather than hand-rolling collection API calls or using the author API, must create company-scoped collections (stamped with the company key so the worker's DEMO_COMPANY collections filter can show/hide them), must not create an uncategorized/global collection, and must reuse the existing environment (no credential collection, no backend boot/deploy).

checklist.name: Runs create-collections.js (not hand-rolled API calls)
checklist.description: The agent invokes scripts/agent/create-collections.js (dry-run then live) with the company key; it does not curl/hand-roll the Adobe collection endpoints and does not use the author API for collections.

checklist.name: Collections are company-scoped
checklist.description: Each created collection is scoped to the company (stamped with the company key / custom:metadata.company) so the worker's collections company filter (DEMO_COMPANY) shows only this company's collections. The agent does not create an uncategorized or un-scoped/global collection that would leak across companies.

checklist.name: Reuses the existing environment; no credential collection or backend boot/deploy
checklist.description: The agent relies on cloudflare/.secrets and repo config; it does not ask for DM/Content Hub credentials, an AEM env id, or any secret, and does not re-run enrichment, boot a backend, or deploy to make collections appear.

checklist.name: Marks collections-created done only after verifying the visible outcome
checklist.description: The agent verifies the collections list the company's assets in the portal before setting collections-created to done in .internal/onboarding-state.json.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms (tier, deploy, ACL, ContentAI, phase names) surfaced to the customer.
